verdict.rationale: Rootly AI SRE investigates alerts and incidents automatically under configurable investigation rules. It tests likely causes against live evidence and analyzes code changes, telemetry (for example AWS CloudWatch via connectors) and past incidents to identify root causes. It also recalls memory and related incidents across investigations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of investigation quality, and detailed first-party docs on change correlation beyond the marketing claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI investigator digs into the probable cause — correlating changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents — before a human even asks

citations.quote: Rootly AI SRE investigates active alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and gives responders a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps.
Rootly AI SRE analyzes your code changes, telemetry, and past incidents to quickly identify root causes and the fix, even if you don't know that code.
Investigation rules decide which alerts Rootly AI SRE investigates automatically
Review the context notes Rootly AI SRE learns from investigations and past incidents, and control which ones it recalls in later investigations.
Rootly AI can look up CloudWatch metrics, EC2 instance state, RDS database status, SQS queue depth, and other AWS services during investigations
